subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

part
solution: The correct answer is **'Whole'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The given word **'part' **means **a portion or division of a whole that is separate or distinct**. (अंश, भाग, खंड, हिस्‍सा) • *** Example: **A** part **of cake was wrapped and saved it for tomorrow.* • ​The marked option** 'Whole'** means** all of; entire**. (पूरा, पूर्ण; सारा-का-सारा, समग्र) • From the given meaning and example sentence, it is obvious that **'Whole'** and** 'Part'** are antonyms. • Thus, the correct answer is **option 4.** ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words given in options:- • **Fragment - **a small part broken off or separated from something. (टुकड़ा) • **Joint - **a point at which parts of an artificial structure are joined. (एक बिंदु जिस पर एक कृत्रिम संरचना के हिस्से जुड़ते हैं) • **Bit - **a small piece, part, or quantity of something. (किसी चीज का छोटा टुकड़ा, भाग या मात्रा) 3f:T65c, The erroneous segment is **'these days is belonging'.**
